signature.name: VTask.sumLexLift
signature.type: {α₁ : Type u_1} -> {α₂ : Type u_2} -> {β₁ : Type u_3} -> {β₂ : Type u_4} -> {γ₁ : Type u_5} -> {γ₂ : Type u_6} -> (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) -> (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) -> (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) -> (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) -> α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂)

conventions.statement: When the first argument is `inr a` and the second is `inl b`, `VTask.sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ (inr a) (inl b) = ∅` for all choices of component functions and inputs.
conventions.note: This junk/boundary value reflects the lexicographic sum order convention: a right-tagged first element is never less than a left-tagged second element, so no interval elements exist.

facts.statement: ∀ {α₁ β₁ γ₁ α₂ β₂ γ₂ : Type*} (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (a : α₁) (b : β₁), VTask.sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inl b) = (f₁ a b).map Function.Embedding.inl

facts.statement: ∀ {α₁ β₁ γ₁ α₂ β₂ γ₂ : Type*} (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (a : α₁) (b : β₂), VTask.sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr b) = (g₁ a b).disjSum (g₂ a b)
